The duplicate behaviour feels right: I want the existing bookmark opened for editing, not a second copy.

Ignoring `www.`, domain capitalisation, and a trailing slash seems sensible. But treating the rest of the address as case-insensitive may be too loose, because some sites can use differently capitalised page addresses for different pages. Those should remain distinct.

Editing the title and description in place also feels right, but the edit action should let me correct the bookmark’s address too—for example, if I saved a mistyped link or the page moved. Once tags and notes are part of an entry, I’d expect to edit those there as well.
